title: Book Plan (host-authored editorial plan; the layout layer turns it into scenes)
description: What an LLM host decides: sequence, roles, which asset goes where, the words, the variant. What it never writes: coordinates. See skills/portfolio-create/SKILL.md 'Book plan'.

composition.description: id from knowledge/patterns/compositions.json; when set, this page is laid out by that slot composition instead of the role default

index.description: true = index-of-sheets page (all listed drawings as numbered thumbnails); repeats are allowed on this page

bleed.description: full-bleed device (from real portfolios): full = one graphic covers the page, title on a panel; split = graphic off three edges beside a text column; top = graphic off the top down to 62 %, text below; grid = 2-4 photos tiled to the trim. Raster photos are cropped to cover; drawings are never cropped.

dark.description: paper/ink swapped on this page (night / model photos on black); use with bleed

strip.description: grid page as one row of equal numbered thumbnails (process strip, 4-10 assets)

photoset.description: template id from knowledge/patterns/photosets.json for 2-6 photographs (row-2, lead-left-3, lead-top-4, mosaic-2-3, grid-2x3 ...); when absent, 3-6 photos on a grid page take the template that fits their aspects best. First asset = lead.

focus.description: focal point [fx, fy] of the page's lead photo as fractions of the source; cover crops (bleed, crop: cover) keep it in view. Default centre.

crop.description: photoset cells are covered (raster photos cropped centred) instead of fitted; the host takes responsibility for the crop (AGENTS.md: high-risk crops need approval)

allow_repeat_assets.description: default false: every asset once; set true only when a repeat is editorially intended

grid_system.description: id from knowledge/patterns/grid-systems.json (one per book; default swiss-12)

band.description: background layer: a coloured band in the margin (cover by default; every_page for a running spine)
